4.speaker: Player
4.text: "We both know that I will have a target on my back after this. I need that immunity."

5.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
5.text: "Of course. This is all about you, Mr. President, isn't it?"

9.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
9.text: "With all due respect, Mr. President. I think you got ahead of yourself. Especially by trying to remove your impeachment procedure and giving yourself immunity. This is too much."

13.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
13.text: "So that you can create your own *Old Guard* and kick everyone with opposing views? The Judiciary must be independent, Mr. President and the clause you removed was a prerequisite of that."

14.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
14.text: "The same assembly that your party controls, by the way."

15.speaker: Player
15.text: "You're still not seeing the complete picture. This proposal is a step towards democratization."

16.speaker: Player
16.text: "We both know that the Old Guard that dominates and obstructs the court needs to be dealt with."

17.speaker: Player
17.text: "I'm not going to deny that. That is the situation."

20.speaker: Player
20.text: "I'm sure we can make a deal."

21.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
21.text: "Mr. President is aiming to destroy the Court and he needs us to do so."

25.speaker: Narrator
25.text: She measured me with her eyes.

28.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
28.text: "I'm not here to make a deal, Mr. President. I'm here to talk."

29.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
29.text: "...But it pains me to say that your proposal has a very low chance of getting through the Supreme Court."

30.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
30.text: "I hope you're not thinking about bribing a Supreme Court Justice."

31.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
31.text: "First of all... Congratulations with the vote in the Grand National Assembly."
31.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Assembly"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_President"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.ErsenCase_Statement_ProBlud"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.ErsenCase_Statement_ProSollist"] == true) == false)

32.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
32.text: "It is you, Mr. President, who shouldn't get ahead of himself."

33.speaker: Narrator
33.text: She stared at me for a few seconds. She seemed to be taken aback by my response.

34.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
34.text: "First of all, I want to congratulate you on the successful vote in the Grand National Assembly..."
34.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Assembly"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_President"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.ErsenCase_Statement_ProBlud"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.ErsenCase_Statement_ProSollist"] == true) == false)

40.speaker: Nia Morgna
40.text: "Bribe? Who do you think we are, Mrs. Edmonds?"

41.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
41.text: "I admire your struggle. Especially because you were strong enough to include concessions from your side."

44.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
44.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Removed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Weaker"] == true)  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == false) == false

46.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
46.text: "Why should I vote for a proposal that will take away my immunity as a Justice? Was this the promised reform? Impeaching a Justice with the decision of the Assembly?"

47.speaker: Player
47.text: "You oppose this because of that one simple clause?"

48.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
48.text: "You made a very clever package, Mr. President. The real gain here is your immunity from impeachment. And..."

49.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
49.text: "You take away our immunity and give it to yourself, and I'm opposing because of a little simple clause?"

52.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
52.text: "What about it? You are already trying to take our right to vote on constitutional legislature and also open a way to impeach us, are you not?"

53.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
53.text: "You are really brave, Mr. President. Trying to go against Tarquin Soll's member of honor rights, huh?"
53.conditionsRaw: (((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Removed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Weaker"] == true)  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == false) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Honorary_Abolished"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Honorary_NoImmunity"] == true)

55.speaker: Player
55.text: "And what do you think about the proposal itself?"

60.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
60.text: "Proper? You are already trying to take our right to vote on constitutional legislature and also open a way to impeach us, are you not?"

62.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
62.text: "This law will not only apply to them but all Justices, Mr. President. Who will protect our rights if you take away our immunity?"

67.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
67.text: "....Using Soll's membership laws for your own benefit? I have to say I don't really like this proposal, no."

71.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
71.text: "You need our wing to vote for you. Otherwise all of your hard work will be in vain."

73.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
73.text: "To start with, I think it's disrespectful."

74.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
74.text: "I am perfectly aware that you need us."

75.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
75.text: "You are packaging it as a democratic reform, yet it smells like an attack against the Supreme Court."

76.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
76.text: "You need our wing to vote for you. Otherwise all of your hard work will be in vain."

79.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
79.text: "But now you face the Supreme Court. And it pains me to say that your proposal has a very low chance of getting through it."

81.speaker: Player
81.text: "And what about the powers of the Supreme Court?"

82.speaker: Player
82.text: "We need proper balance of power, Mrs. Edmonds. Try to see the bigger picture."

87.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
87.text: "You are aiming to destroy the Court and you need us to do so."

91.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
91.text: "Why should I vote for a proposal that will take away my immunity as a Justice? Was this the promised reform? Removing Justices however you see fit?"

92.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
92.text: "You are expanding the powers of the president, which already is very powerful. "

103.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
103.text: "First of all, I want to congratulate you on the successful vote in the Grand National Assembly..."
103.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_BludishRights_Amendment_Proposal"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.ErsenCase_Statement_ProBlud"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.ErsenCase_Statement_ProSollist"] == true) == false)

105.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
105.text: "...But it pains me to say that your *updated* proposal has a very low chance of getting through the Supreme Court."

106.speaker: Player
106.text: "And what do you think about the proposal itself?"

110.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
110.text: "What I think really doesn't matter with a proposal like this."

111.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
111.text: "Changing Article 6 and 7? Removing 'Sord' from the Constitution?"

113.speaker: Player
113.text: "The discrimination and oppression that many Bludish people face in this country."

114.speaker: Player
114.text: "The Assembly proved many wrong by passing it, Ms. Edmonds. The atmosphere in this country is now changing."

115.speaker: Player
115.text: "You know those changes are about equality and rights, Justice Edmonds."

117.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
117.text: "You know you need the other justices to vote for it too, Mr. President."

118.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
118.text: "Try explaining that to the Sollists and the Sordists."

119.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
119.text: "I thought you were a tactical man, Mr. President. But you decided to gamble with your reforms."

120.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
120.text: "What matters is the atmosphere of the Supreme Court, Mr. President."

124.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
124.text: "But before we get bogged down in details, I must say I find your proposal disrespectful."

125.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
125.text: "And now you need our wing to vote for you. Otherwise all of your hard work will be in vain."

127.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
127.text: "But before we get bogged down in details, I must say this."

128.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
128.text: "You are really brave. Trying to go against Tarquin Soll's member of honor rights, huh?"

132.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
132.text: "I admire your struggle. Especially because you were strong enough to include concessions from your side."

135.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
135.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Removed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Weaker"] == true)  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == false) == false

136.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
136.text: "You don't have a strong position here."
136.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Honorary_Abolished"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Honorary_NoImmunity"] == true) == false) and (((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Removed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Weaker"] == true)  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == false) == false)

138.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
138.text: "You know, Mr. President... Since you tried to intervene with the Court's decision on Mr. Ersen's case, there is quite a bit of hostility against you."

145.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
145.text: "But before that, I want to congratulate you on the successful vote in the Grand National Assembly..."

146.speaker: Isabel Edmonds
146.text: "You know, Mr. President... Since you tried to intervene with the Court's decision on Mr. Ersen's case, you created some hostility against yourself among my wing."
